meta_description:
4,038 likes, 159 comments - simonsinek on October 27, 2026: "“You don’t look your age!” While it sounds like a compliment, what if we weren’t so afraid of ‘looking our age?’

Gerontologist Dr. Kerry Burnight (@the_gerontologist) says comments like this are a sign of how deep society’s ageism runs.

She says the research is clear: a lot of things get BETTER as we get older. Maybe it’s time we start embracing getting to age, knowing the good parts are still to come.

🎧 Listen to the full episode of A Bit of Optimism wherever you get your podcasts.".
